text: A woman with red hair, glowing eyes, kneeling on a glowing circle. She wears a white draped garment tied at the waist with blue beads. Her skin is pale, build slender. Hair long, wavy, framing her face. Face oval, sharp cheekbones. One hand rests near a wall, other near ground. Barefoot. Appears to be casting or channeling magic from the circle beneath her. Background dimly lit with pottery and lanterns.
